question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4 **- **Ockupation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is '**Occupation**' with a double '**c**'.
 
• The incorrect spelling '**Ockupation**' has only one '**c**' and is not a valid spelling of the word.
 
• The error is a misspelling of the word due to the omission of a letter.
 
• It is important to pay attention to the correct spelling of words to avoid confusion and miscommunication.
